findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Pushing more data than the buffer size can hold
findings.assumptions: The queue does not properly handle overflow conditions and writes past the buffer boundary.

findings.title: Race Condition
findings.untrusted_source: Data pushed and popped by threads
findings.trigger: Concurrent access to the queue by multiple threads without proper synchronization
findings.assumptions: The queue operations are not thread-safe, leading to race conditions.

findings.title: Resource Leak
findings.trigger: Failure to properly clean up resources if initialization fails
findings.assumptions: There is no cleanup mechanism if the queue initialization fails.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the data pushed into the queue is later used in a system call, it could lead to command injection
findings.assumptions: The data pushed into the queue might be used in a system call later in the program.
